_schema.note: Phase 10 per-roast sensory IDEAL. LABEL CONCEPT REMOVED (2026-05-21 — blueprint docs/PHASE10_SENSORY_REFOUNDING.md §0): for a fixed bean+roast+brewer there is a single 'good', not N co-equal flavor targets — so the v4 multi-label islands (balanced/acid-forward/sweet-body/coarse-modern/tim) are dropped. Layer 2 target = ONE 6-axis sensory IDEAL per roast; axes = acidity/sweetness/body/bitterness/astringency/roast in models.sensory.SENSORY_AXES order. Each IDEAL = predict_axes(**anchor_brew). Confidence tiers: medium_light = literature anchor (Hoffman, measured TDS, stable); light = user tim feedback (provisional — re-derive after Step 4); medium / moderately_dark = deterministic placeholders. Filename labels.json + module models/labels.py keep their (now-misnomer) names until Step 5 rewrites the scoring chain. After Step 3 the old scoring chain (models/scoring.py, models/labels.py:ideal_abs, diagnose_anchor.py, tests/) is stale until Step 5/7 — expected Phase 10 transitional state. Detail: docs/PHASE10_STEP3_LABELS.md.

fields.ideal: 6 sensory axis target intensities (acidity/sweetness/body/bitterness/astringency/roast). Scale = CATA detection frequency, nominally [0,1]; do NOT sum to 1 — independent intensities, not mass fractions. Bullseye for the Step 5 sensory-space distance score.
fields.anchor_brew: the Layer 1 point {tds,ey,roast,dial} the IDEAL was derived from via predict_axes(). Traceability / reproducibility / Step 4 thin-Layer-1 calibration reference. NOT a scoring field.
fields.seed: provenance + confidence tier of this roast's IDEAL.

light.seed: user tim ⭐4 feedback recipe (Tim Wendelboe Nordic light-roast style), recomputed through the current Layer 1 (XL 400ml) → TDS 1.413 / EY 19.88. PROVISIONAL: tim is not a Layer 1 calibration anchor, so its recipe→(TDS,EY) mapping will shift when Step 4 replaces Layer 1 → re-derive after Step 4. The n=3 tim bracket ranks correctly by sensory distance (⭐4 0.000 < ⭐3 0.026 < ⭐2 0.037).
light.description: 淺焙（Nordic 真淺焙 / Tim Wendelboe 風）。roast 軸為各焙度最低、酸質明亮。模型尚無『淺焙明亮 vs 悶』訊號 → feedback 第一精修對象。

medium_light.seed: Hoffman literature anchor — measured TDS 1.23, stable across the Step 4 Layer 1 rewrite (Hoffman is itself a Layer 1 calibration anchor). The user's two ⭐5 feedback cups recompute to ~1.23/18 and sit only dist 0.043 from this IDEAL → independent confirmation that the Hoffman target is this user's 'good'.
medium_light.description: 中淺焙（Hoffman El Tambo 風；本系統校準最紮實的焙度）。六軸皆不極端、酸與苦適中、帶焙烤底韻。

medium.seed: PLACEHOLDER — deterministic: predict_axes at medium_light's brew point (1.23/21/dial 4.3) with the `medium` roast offset. No anchor, no feedback. Refine when a medium-roast cup is logged.
medium.description: 中焙。佔位用 —— 無錨點、無 feedback，沿 _ROAST_OFFSET 自 medium_light 推得。

moderately_dark.seed: PLACEHOLDER — deterministic: predict_axes at medium_light's brew point (1.23/21/dial 4.3) with the `moderately_dark` roast offset. No anchor, no feedback.
moderately_dark.description: 中深焙。佔位用 —— 無錨點、無 feedback，沿 _ROAST_OFFSET 自 medium_light 推得。
